name: Household Ledger - Price Refresh Agent (SCAFFOLD, not deployed)

parameters.content:
## SCAFFOLD — NOT DEPLOYED
This workflow is a draft, modeled on Beautiful Nature Scenes' Content Calendar Generator (gap-detection) and Tally Sorter (clear+append). It has never been run.

SETUP TODOs before activating:
1. Replace `documentId` on every Google Sheets node with the real Household Ledger spreadsheet ID.
2. Connect a Google Sheets credential.
3. Resolve Open Decision #1 (household-ledger-architecture.md §8): does 'Fetch Price Source' hit a known store product-page URL per item, or a general web-search API? That node is a placeholder either way — wire it once decided.
4. Connect a Claude/Anthropic credential for the extraction step (replace `REPLACE_WITH_ANTHROPIC_CREDENTIAL_ID`).
5. SCHEMA EXTENSION NEEDED: `PriceLog` (currently item/store/price/date per household-ledger-sheets-schema.md) needs two more columns for this workflow's 24-48h freshness gate to work: `status` (pending/promoted) and `scraped_at` (full timestamp, not just date — the gate is measured in hours). Not yet added to the schema doc.

Two independent branches, both off the same weekly trigger:
BRANCH A (top): finds stale Catalog items, scrapes+extracts a new price, stages it in PriceLog as 'pending' rather than trusting it immediately.
BRANCH B (bottom): promotes PriceLog entries that have sat as 'pending' for the configured hold period with no newer conflicting scrape — this is the 24-48h freshness gate from CLAUDE.md/architecture.md §5, implemented as a two-step stage-then-promote rather than a bare scrape-and-trust path.

Failure handling: an item that fails extraction validation is logged via a NoOp node for now (see its own note) rather than retried automatically — matches the existing Webhook Agent's 'acceptable for v1, revisit later' precedent, not a gap unique to this workflow.

nodes.name: Weekly Refresh Trigger
nodes.notes: Weekly by default — CLAUDE.md flags the n8n plan's monthly execution cap (~55 items x 2 stores adds up fast if scheduled too often). Adjust once real usage shows how often prices actually move.

nodes.name: Fetch Price Source (PLACEHOLDER)
nodes.notes: Open Decision #1 (household-ledger-architecture.md §8): known store product-page URL per item, or a general web-search API? Stubbed either way — wire once decided.

nodes.name: Extract Price via LLM (PLACEHOLDER)
nodes.notes: Structured-JSON-only extraction per CLAUDE.md's 'never free text' rule. Same shape ME101 uses for its equivalent agent (~38.5% early failure rate there per the Master Work Log) — validation happens in the next node, not here.

nodes.name: Stage in PriceLog as Pending
nodes.notes: Uses the proposed status/scraped_at schema extension — see Setup Notes. This is the 'stage' half of the 24-48h freshness gate; Catalog itself isn't touched here.

nodes.name: Log Extraction Failure (v1)
nodes.notes: v1: no persistent failure log, no retry — same 'acceptable for v1, revisit later' shape as the existing Webhook Agent's Delete Row node. A v2 could append to a failures sheet or alert via Telegram after N consecutive failures for the same item.

nodes.name: Mark PriceLog Entry Promoted
nodes.notes: Prevents this same entry being re-promoted on next week's run.
